svg.title: Aiven Docs RAG MCP Architecture and Hybrid Retrieval Flow
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing MCP clients connecting over stdio and HTTP to the MCP tool layer and RagService, which ingests Aiven devportal docs through heading-aware chunking and local ONNX embeddings into PostgreSQL pgvector, and answers queries via hybrid RRF fusion and cross-encoder reranking.
svg.text: Why two-stage retrieval? Hybrid RRF guarantees 0.94 recall in top-20 (~28ms),
then the cross-encoder lifts precision to 0.81 hit@1 and 1.00 hit@5 (~540ms).
